requirements.summary: Fix the 'Cannot read property toString' error that occurs when a country is selected in the country selection flow
acceptanceCriteria: Country selection completes without throwing toString errors
All country selection flows (EU VAT intro, UK, country transaction steps) handle undefined/null values safely
Error does not reoccur after country is selected

file_operations.description: Add null safety checks to the country selection onChange handler. Ensure the selected country object is validated before accessing properties like code or calling methods. Guard against undefined/null country values when setting the selected country in the URL parameters or state.

Add null safety checks to all country selection onChange handlers in both EU and UK tabs. Validate country object existence before accessing properties or calling toString-like methods. Ensure safe handling when updating URL parameters or triggering navigation after country selection.

Add null safety checks to the customer country selection onChange handler. Validate the selected country object before accessing its code property or passing it to other functions. Guard against undefined/null values when the country selection changes.

Review and strengthen the setSelectedSellerCountry function to handle edge cases where the country parameter might be undefined or null. Add explicit validation before calling any methods on the country object or accessing its properties.

requirements.summary: Add null safety checks to all country selection onChange handlers to prevent undefined crashes when accessing country properties
acceptanceCriteria: All country code references are guarded with optional chaining or explicit null checks
Country object property access (like .toString()) includes null/undefined validation
No console errors appear during country selection interactions

file_operations.description: Add null safety checks to any country selection handlers if present. Validate country objects before accessing properties or converting to strings. Ensure safe handling of optional customer country selections in UK transaction flows.

Review URL parameter extraction and setting functions to ensure they handle undefined/null values gracefully. Add validation when setting country-related parameters to prevent toString errors on undefined values.
